But Blue dart so called express service takes 3 working days just to arrive to the nearest hub which is 2 miles away from me, and then keep waiting for the delivery (8 hrs and counting) this time. The last time, their express service took 4 BD to deliver (this was hardly 7 months ago). I am not sure if it's them or the seller, but I have email from the seller with express delivery. featured_reviews.review_text:

Extremely unprofessional behavior and poor customer service. I would not recommend this courier service if you value your belongings.
